bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to low-income support; appropriating money for a grant to Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches for drop-in support services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GREATER MINNEAPOLIS COUNCIL OF CHURCHES DROP-IN SUPPORT SERVICES.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches to provide drop-in support services. Grant funds must be used to provide:

(1) hot, prepared meals and takeaway food bags that increase access to nutritious, healthy, and culturally appropriate food;

(2) hygiene supplies, including towels and washcloths, toothpaste and toothbrushes, shampoo and soap, menstrual products, and clean clothes and undergarments;

(3) hats, gloves, hand warmers, and blankets; and

(4) access to resources for housing, employment, and social services.
